title: Relabeling preserves well-formedness
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with state set $S$, and let $e:S\to S'$ be a bijection. If the query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states of $M$ are pairwise distinct, then the machine obtained by relabeling every designated state and every transition successor via $e$ also has pairwise distinct query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states.
hypotheses_covered: The three designated states of $M$ are pairwise distinct
